name: Symbol of Pain Trap (CR 6)
body:
Symbol of Pain Trap
CR 6

XP 2,400

Type magic; Perception DC 30; Disable Device DC 30

Trigger location; Duration 90 minutes; Reset none

EFFECTS

Spell effect (symbol of pain, CL 9th, DC 19 Fortitude save negates); multiple targets (all targets in a 60-ft.-radius burst)
